name: CO2 to urea and polymers
principle: Urea plants consume CO2 from ammonia production as a feedstock, and Covestro makes CO2-based polyether carbonate polyols for polyurethane foam. Covestro's Dormagen polyols plant, started in 2016, has a capacity of 5,000 t/yr and supports foams that contain about 20% CO2.

source.note: European Rubber Journal, Covestro starts CO2-based polyols plant, 20 June 2016

limitations: Limited volume compared with storage (not quantified in sources read)
